items.difficulty_reason: The counted unit is the author's own lemma lemma-proper-base-change-f-star at source lines 450-457: for a proper f : X -> Y, its base change f' along g : Y' -> Y and any sheaf F on X_etale, one has g^{-1}f_*F = f'_*(g')^{-1}F. The author's proof at source lines 459-498 reduces to affine schemes: the question is etale local on Y', so one may replace Y' and Y by schemes V', V and then work Zariski locally, reaching the affine case; there one chooses a surjective proper h_1 : X_1 -> X with X_1 a scheme by Chow's lemma (a cross-chapter pointer), sets X_2 = X_1 x_X X_1, applies the scheme case of the statement (a second pointer) to the two cartesian squares with the sheaves F_i, and concludes from the exact sequence 0 -> F -> h_{1,*}F_1 -> h_{2,*}F_2 supplied by the chapter's lemma on surjective proper morphisms (retained as context), the same sequence holding after pullback because X'_2 = X'_1 x_{X'} X'_1. The author closes with 'some details omitted'; that remark is reproduced verbatim and the card supplies nothing in its place.
